book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 1: The Number System covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Sets of Numbers: Natural to Real Numbers
topics.description: Natural numbers (N), Whole numbers (W), Integers (Z), Rational numbers (Q), Irrational numbers (Q'), Real numbers (R).

topics.title: Irrational Numbers and Radicals
topics.description: Proving irrationality of √2, terminating vs repeating decimals, simplifying radicals and rationalizing denominators.

topics.title: Absolute Value and Intervals of Real Numbers
topics.description: Properties of absolute value |x|, open, closed, half-open intervals, and representation on the real number line.

topics.title: Exponents and Scientific Notation
topics.description: Laws of integral exponents, zero and negative exponents, fractional exponents, and scientific standard form.

book_chapters.title: Unit 1: The Number System

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 2: Equations and Inequalities covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Linear Equations in One Variable
topics.description: Solving ax + b = c, equations involving brackets and fractions, word problems involving speed, age, and money.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations in Two Variables
topics.description: Elimination method, substitution method, graphical intersection method, unique solution, infinitely many, or no solution.

topics.title: Linear Inequalities in One Variable
topics.description: Solving linear inequalities, reversing inequality symbol on multiplying/dividing by negative, solution sets.

topics.title: Quadratic Equations by Factoring and Quadratic Formula
topics.description: Standard form ax² + bx + c = 0, solving by factoring, completing the square, and using the quadratic formula x = (-b ± √(b²-4ac))/(2a).

book_chapters.title: Unit 2: Equations and Inequalities

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Relations and Functions covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: The Cartesian Coordinate Plane and Relations
topics.description: Ordered pairs (x, y), quadrants, Cartesian product A × B, definition of a relation as a subset of Cartesian product.

topics.title: Domain and Range of a Relation
topics.description: Set of all first elements (domain), set of all second elements (range), arrow diagrams and graphs.

topics.title: Concept and Definition of a Function
topics.description: Functions as special relations where each input has unique output, vertical line test, function notation f(x).

topics.title: Linear Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: f(x) = mx + c, gradient (slope) m, y-intercept c, table of values, parallel and perpendicular slopes.

topics.title: Quadratic Functions and Parabolic Graphs
topics.description: f(x) = ax² + bx + c, vertex coordinates (-b/2a, f(-b/2a)), axis of symmetry, opening upwards (a > 0) or downwards (a < 0).

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Relations and Functions

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Geometry covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Angles, Parallel Lines and Transversals
topics.description: Complementary, supplementary angles, vertically opposite angles, alternate interior angles, corresponding angles.

topics.title: Triangles: Classification and Angle Sum Property
topics.description: Equilateral, isosceles, scalene, acute, obtuse, right-angled triangles; interior angle sum = 180°, exterior angle theorem.

topics.title: Congruence and Similarity of Triangles
topics.description: SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS congruence; similarity ratios, scale factors, finding unknown sides in similar geometric figures.

topics.title: The Pythagorean Theorem and Special Right Triangles
topics.description: a² + b² = c², Pythagorean triples (3-4-5, 5-12-13), 30°-60°-90° and 45°-45°-90° triangle side ratios.

topics.title: Quadrilaterals and Polygons
topics.description: Parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square, trapezium properties; sum of interior angles (n-2) × 180°.

book_chapters.title: Unit 4: Geometry

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 5: Circles covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Parts of a Circle: Radius, Diameter, Chord, Arc, Sector
topics.description: Definitions and geometric notation of circle components, concentric circles, cyclic relationships.

topics.title: Central Angles, Inscribed Angles and Arcs
topics.description: Measure of central angle equals intercepted arc, inscribed angle is half of intercepted arc.

topics.title: Arc Length and Area of a Sector
topics.description: Circumference C = 2πr, area A = πr², arc length s = (θ/360) × 2πr, sector area = (θ/360) × πr².

topics.title: Tangents to a Circle
topics.description: Tangent line is perpendicular to radius at point of contact, lengths of two tangents drawn from external point are equal.

book_chapters.title: Unit 5: Circles

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 6: Solid Figures covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Prisms and Cylinders: Surface Area and Volume
topics.description: Right rectangular prisms, triangular prisms, right circular cylinders; lateral area, total surface area, volume V = Base area × height.

topics.title: Pyramids and Cones: Surface Area and Volume
topics.description: Slant height vs vertical height, lateral area, total surface area, volume V = (1/3) × Base area × height.

topics.title: Spheres and Hemispheres
topics.description: Surface area of sphere A = 4πr², volume of sphere V = (4/3)πr³, volume and curved surface of hemisphere.

topics.title: Composite Solids and Applied Problems
topics.description: Determining total material requirement, capacity of water tanks, grain silos in Ethiopian agriculture.

book_chapters.title: Unit 6: Solid Figures

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 7: Coordinate Geometry covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Distance Between Two Points in Cartesian Plane
topics.description: Derivation from Pythagorean theorem d = √[(x2-x1)² + (y2-y1)²], distance from origin.

topics.title: Midpoint Formula of a Line Segment
topics.description: Coordinates of midpoint M = ((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2), finding endpoint when midpoint and one endpoint are given.

topics.title: Slope (Gradient) of a Straight Line
topics.description: m = (y2-y1)/(x2-x1) = rise/run, positive, negative, zero (horizontal), undefined (vertical) slopes.

topics.title: Equations of Straight Lines
topics.description: Slope-intercept form y = mx + c, point-slope form y - y1 = m(x - x1), determining parallel and perpendicular lines.

book_chapters.title: Unit 7: Coordinate Geometry

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 8: Statistics and Probability covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Data Collection, Organization and Frequency Tables
topics.description: Primary vs secondary data, tally marks, discrete frequency distribution tables, grouped frequency distribution.

topics.title: Graphical Representation: Bar Charts, Histograms and Pie Charts
topics.description: Constructing and interpreting bar graphs, frequency histograms, frequency polygons, calculating sector angles for pie charts.

topics.title: Measures of Central Tendency: Mean, Median, and Mode
topics.description: Calculating mean for ungrouped data, identifying median (middle value), finding mode (most frequent value).

topics.title: Basic Probability Concepts
topics.description: Random experiments, sample space S, event E, theoretical probability P(E) = n(E)/n(S), impossible and certain events, complement of event.

book_chapters.title: Unit 8: Statistics and Probability

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 9: Regular Polygons covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Properties of Regular Polygons
topics.description: Equilateral and equiangular polygons, interior and exterior angle calculations, and apothem.

topics.title: Perimeter and Area of Regular Polygons
topics.description: Formula A = (1/2) · perimeter · apothem, inscribed and circumscribed regular polygons.

topics.title: Geometric Constructions and Tessellations
topics.description: Compass and straightedge constructions of regular hexagons, pentagons, and tessellations in Ethiopian architecture.

book_chapters.title: Unit 9: Regular Polygons

topics.title: Introduction to Vectors and Scalars
topics.description: Magnitude and direction, vector notation, geometric representation of displacement and velocity.

topics.title: Component Form and Vector Operations
topics.description: Vector components (x, y), vector addition using triangle/parallelogram rules, and scalar multiplication.

topics.title: Magnitude, Unit Vectors and Applied Vector Problems
topics.description: Calculating magnitude |v| = √(x² + y²), standard unit vectors i and j, and practical navigation vectors.

topics.title: Role of Physics in Technology, Engineering and Medicine
topics.description: Electrification, telecommunications, medical imaging (X-rays, ultrasound), transportation, and renewable energy in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Physics in Ethiopian National Development
topics.description: Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) hydroelectricity, solar energy potentials, infrastructure construction, and industrialization.

topics.title: Fundamental and Derived Physical Quantities
topics.description: The 7 fundamental quantities (length, mass, time, electric current, temperature, amount of substance, luminous intensity) vs derived quantities.

topics.title: SI Base Units, Derived Units and Metric Prefixes
topics.description: Definitions of meter, kilogram, second; prefixes (kilo, mega, giga, milli, micro, nano) and unit conversion techniques.

topics.title: Measurement of Length, Mass, Volume and Time
topics.description: Vernier caliper reading, micrometer screw gauge zero error and readings, beam balance, stopwatch.

topics.title: Errors in Measurement and Significant Figures
topics.description: Systematic vs random errors, precision vs accuracy, counting significant figures and rounding rules.

topics.title: Scalars and Vectors: Basic Introduction
topics.description: Differences between scalar quantities (magnitude only) and vector quantities (magnitude and direction), vector arrows.

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Motion in a Straight Line covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Position, Distance, and Displacement
topics.description: Reference frames, one-dimensional coordinate line, path length vs shortest straight-line vector.

topics.title: Speed and Velocity
topics.description: Average speed, instantaneous speed, average velocity, instantaneous velocity, uniform velocity.

topics.title: Acceleration
topics.description: Definition of acceleration a = (v - u)/t, positive acceleration, deceleration (retardation), uniform acceleration.

topics.title: Equations of Uniformly Accelerated Motion
topics.description: Derivation and problem solving using: v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5at², v² = u² + 2as, s = ((u + v)/2)t.

topics.title: Graphical Representation of Motion and Free Fall under Gravity
topics.description: Slope of s-t graph (velocity), slope of v-t graph (acceleration), area under v-t graph (displacement), free fall g = 9.8 m/s².

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Motion in a Straight Line

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Force and Newton's Laws of Motion
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Force and Newton's Laws of Motion covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Concept of Force and Classification of Forces
topics.description: Force as push or pull, contact forces (friction, tension, normal force) vs non-contact field forces (gravitational, magnetic, electrostatic).

topics.title: Newton's First Law of Motion and Inertia
topics.description: Law of inertia, mass as measure of inertia, balanced forces, and equilibrium of bodies.

topics.title: Newton's Second Law of Motion and Momentum
topics.description: F_net = ma, momentum p = mv, impulse of a force J = FΔt = Δp, and SI units (Newton and kg·m/s).

topics.title: Newton's Third Law of Motion and Action-Reaction Pairs
topics.description: Every action has equal and opposite reaction, action-reaction pairs acting on different bodies, rocket propulsion.

topics.title: Frictional Forces: Causes, Types, and Applications
topics.description: Static friction, limiting friction, kinetic friction, coefficients of friction, methods to reduce and increase friction.

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 5: Work, Energy, and Power covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Work Done by a Constant Force
topics.description: Definition W = F·s·cos θ, positive, negative and zero work, SI unit of work (Joule).

topics.title: Kinetic Energy and Gravitational Potential Energy
topics.description: Kinetic energy KE = 0.5mv², work-energy theorem, gravitational potential energy PE = mgh.

topics.title: Law of Conservation of Mechanical Energy
topics.description: Total mechanical energy E = KE + PE is constant in absence of dissipative forces, swinging pendulum, falling body.

topics.title: Power and Energy Efficiency
topics.description: Rate of doing work P = W/t = F·v, SI unit (Watt), horsepower conversion, calculation of percentage efficiency.

book_chapters.title: Unit 5: Work, Energy, and Power

topics.title: Levers: Classification and Principles
topics.description: Principle of moments, class 1 levers (fulcrum in middle), class 2 levers (load in middle), class 3 levers (effort in middle).

topics.title: Pulleys and Pulley Systems
topics.description: Single fixed pulley (VR=1), single movable pulley (VR=2), block and tackle systems (VR = number of rope segments).

topics.title: Inclined Plane, Wedge, Screw, Wheel and Axle
topics.description: Formulas for VR of inclined plane (length/height), screw jack, wheel and axle, practical simple machines in Ethiopian daily life.

topics.title: Chemistry in Industry, Medicine and Agriculture

topics.description: Base SI units (meter, kilogram, second, kelvin, mole) and derived units (volume, density, concentration).

topics.title: Scientific Notation, Metric Prefixes and Precision
topics.description: Expressing large/small numbers in exponential form (N × 10^n), mega, kilo, centi, milli, micro, nano prefixes.

topics.title: Significant Figures and Uncertainty in Measurement
topics.description: Rules for counting significant figures, rounding off rules in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

topics.title: Dimensional Analysis (Factor-Label Method)
topics.description: Conversion factors, unit cancellations, density problems (d = m/V), and multi-step metric unit conversions.

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Atomic Structure and Periodic Table covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Historical Development of the Atomic Model
topics.description: Dalton atomic theory, Thomson cathode ray experiment and plum pudding model, Rutherford gold foil experiment and nuclear atom.

topics.title: Subatomic Particles: Protons, Neutrons and Electrons
topics.description: Charges, relative masses, and locations of particles within the atomic nucleus and extranuclear cloud.

topics.title: Atomic Number, Mass Number, and Isotopes
topics.description: Z and A notation, calculation of neutrons (A - Z), isotopes of hydrogen and carbon, and calculating relative atomic mass.

topics.title: Bohr Model and Electron Energy Levels
topics.description: Quantized energy shells (K, L, M, N), electron configuration (2n² rule) for elements with atomic numbers 1 to 20.

topics.title: Structure of the Modern Periodic Table
topics.description: Mendeleev periodic law vs Moseley modern law, periods (1-7), groups (1-18), metals, nonmetals, and metalloids.

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Atomic Structure and Periodic Table

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Periodic Properties of the Elements
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Periodic Properties of the Elements covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Valence Electrons and Group Valency
topics.description: Determining group number from outer shell electrons, period number from highest occupied principal energy level.

topics.title: Trends in Atomic Size and Ionic Radius
topics.description: Nuclear charge effect, shielding effect, atomic radius decrease across a period and increase down a group; cation vs anion sizes.

topics.title: Ionization Energy Trends
topics.description: First ionization energy definition (M(g) -> M+(g) + e-), periodic trends across periods and down groups, noble gas stability.

topics.title: Electron Affinity and Electronegativity
topics.description: Definition of electron affinity and electronegativity (Pauling scale), halogen electronegativity, metallic to nonmetallic character trends.

topics.title: The Octet Rule and Chemical Stability
topics.description: Noble gas configuration (s²p⁶), octet rule, Lewis electron dot structures of atoms and simple ions.

topics.title: Ionic (Electrovalent) Bonding
topics.description: Transfer of valence electrons from metal to nonmetal, electrostatic attraction, ionic crystal lattice, and properties of ionic solids.

topics.title: Covalent Bonding and Molecular Compounds

topics.title: Speaking: Debating the Ethics and Boundaries of AI Systems

topics.title: Reading: Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision Applications
topics.description: Comprehending computer science literature, identifying technical metaphors, and assessing AI in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Computer Science, Algorithms & Data Ethics

topics.title: Grammar: Advanced Cohesive Devices and Discourse Markers

topics.title: Arithmetic Sequences and Series
topics.description: Common difference d, recursive definition, general n-th term a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d, arithmetic means, partial sum S_n = n/2(2a_1 + (n-1)d) = n/2(a_1 + a_n).

topics.title: Geometric Sequences and Series
topics.description: Common ratio r, general term a_n = a_1·r^(n-1), geometric means, sum of finite geometric series S_n = a_1(1-r^n)/(1-r), convergence conditions and infinite sum S_inf = a_1/(1-r) for |r| < 1.

topics.title: Sigma Notation and Mathematical Induction
topics.description: Properties of summation operator Σ, index shifts, linearity of sums, the Principle of Mathematical Induction (Base step, Inductive hypothesis, Inductive proof step).

topics.title: Real-World Applications of Sequences and Series
topics.description: Compound interest formulas A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), simple annuities, depreciation models, biological cell division sequences, and national economic growth projections.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Introduction to Limits and Continuity
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 2: Introduction to Limits and Continuity covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Intuitive and Algebraic Concept of Limits
topics.description: Definition of limits, one-sided limits (left-hand and right-hand), limit laws (sum, product, quotient, power), and evaluating limits by factoring, expansion, and conjugate rationalization.

topics.title: Limits Involving Infinity and Indeterminate Forms
topics.description: Infinite limits, limits at infinity, resolving 0/0 and inf/inf forms, identifying horizontal and vertical asymptotes of rational functions, and Squeeze (Sandwich) Theorem.

topics.title: Continuity of Functions
topics.description: Three conditions for continuity at a point (f(c) defined, lim f(x) exists, lim f(x) = f(c)), continuity on intervals, removable vs essential discontinuities, and Intermediate Value Theorem (IVT).

topics.title: Special Trigonometric Limits
topics.description: Fundamental limit lim(x->0) [sin(x)/x] = 1, lim(x->0) [(1 - cos(x))/x] = 0, and evaluating trigonometric indeterminate limits in EUEE.

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Introduction to Differential Calculus covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: The Derivative as an Instantaneous Rate of Change
topics.description: Difference quotient, limit definition f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)]/h, geometric slope of tangent line, instantaneous velocity and acceleration.

topics.title: Fundamental Rules of Differentiation
topics.description: Constant rule, Power rule d/dx(x^n) = n·x^(n-1), Constant multiple rule, Sum and difference rules, Product rule (uv)' = u'v + uv', Quotient rule (u/v)' = (u'v - uv')/v^2.

topics.title: The Chain Rule and Implicit Differentiation
topics.description: Derivatives of composite functions dy/dx = (dy/du)·(du/dx), extended power rule, implicit differentiation for curves F(x, y) = 0, higher order derivatives f''(x) and f^(n)(x).

topics.title: Derivatives of Trigonometric, Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
topics.description: Derivatives of sin x, cos x, tan x, sec x, e^x, a^x, ln x, log_a x, and logarithmic differentiation for complex products.

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Introduction to Differential Calculus

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Applications of Differential Calculus covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Critical Points, Monotonicity and Extreme Values
topics.description: Critical numbers (where f'(c) = 0 or undefined), Fermat's Theorem, Extreme Value Theorem on closed intervals [a, b], First Derivative Test for local maxima and minima.

topics.title: Concavity, Points of Inflection and Curve Sketching
topics.description: Second derivative test for local extrema, concavity test (f''(x) > 0 concave up, f''(x) < 0 concave down), points of inflection, combining asymptotes and intercepts for complete curve sketching.

topics.title: Applied Optimization Problems
topics.description: Translating word problems into objective functions, constraints, domain restrictions, maximizing profit/area/volume, minimizing cost/material in construction and commerce.

topics.title: Related Rates of Change
topics.description: Differentiating with respect to time t using chain rule, geometric modeling (expanding spherical balloons, draining conical tanks, sliding ladders, shadow movement).

book_chapters.title: Unit 4: Applications of Differential Calculus

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 5: Introduction to Integral Calculus covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Antiderivatives and Indefinite Integrals
topics.description: Definition of antiderivative, indefinite integral symbol ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C, power rule for integration ∫ x^n dx = (x^(n+1))/(n+1) + C (n ≠ -1), integrals of trigonometric and exponential functions.

topics.title: Integration by Substitution (u-Substitution)
topics.description: Reversing the chain rule: ∫ f(g(x))g'(x) dx = ∫ f(u) du, choosing appropriate substitution variable u, transforming differentials and limits of integration.

topics.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (FTC)
topics.description: Riemann sums and area under curve, Part 1: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t) dt = f(x), Part 2: ∫_a^b f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a), properties of definite integrals (linearity, additivity of intervals).

topics.title: Applications of Definite Integrals
topics.description: Calculating exact planar area between curves f(x) and g(x), net displacement vs total distance traveled given velocity v(t), average value of a continuous function.

book_chapters.title: Unit 5: Introduction to Integral Calculus

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Three Dimensional Geometry and Vectors
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 6: Three Dimensional Geometry and Vectors covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Vectors and Coordinate System in Three-Dimensional Space
topics.description: Right-handed 3D Cartesian coordinates (x, y, z), distance formula in 3D d = √((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2 + (z2-z1)^2), midpoint formula, standard unit vectors i, j, k.

topics.title: Scalar (Dot) Product and Vector Projections in 3D
topics.description: Dot product u·v = u1v1 + u2v2 + u3v3 = |u||v|cos θ, orthogonality criterion (u·v = 0), direction cosines, scalar and vector projections proj_v u.

topics.title: Cross Product of Vectors in 3D Space
topics.description: Vector product u × v, determinant calculation, magnitude |u × v| = |u||v|sin θ (area of parallelogram), right-hand rule for direction, collinearity condition u × v = 0.

topics.title: Equations of Lines and Planes in 3D Space
topics.description: Vector and parametric equations of lines in space r(t) = r_0 + t·v, symmetric equations, standard equation of a plane A(x - x0) + B(y - y0) + C(z - z0) = 0 using normal vector n.

book_chapters.title: Unit 6: Three Dimensional Geometry and Vectors

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 1: Thermodynamics and Heat Engines covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Zeroth and First Laws of Thermodynamics
topics.description: Thermal equilibrium and temperature concept (Zeroth law); Internal energy U, heat Q, and work done W; First law ΔU = Q - W; Thermodynamic processes: Isochoric (W = 0), Isobaric (W = PΔV), Isothermal (ΔU = 0, Q = W), Adiabatic (Q = 0, ΔU = -W).

topics.title: Molar Heat Capacities and Ideal Gas Work
topics.description: Molar heat capacity at constant volume Cv and constant pressure Cp; Mayer's relation Cp - Cv = R; adiabatic index γ = Cp/Cv; PV diagram work calculation W = area under PV curve.

topics.title: Second Law of Thermodynamics and Entropy
topics.description: Kelvin-Planck statement (no heat engine can convert 100% of absorbed heat into work); Clausius statement (heat cannot spontaneously flow from cold to hot reservoir); Entropy S as measure of disorder, ΔS ≥ 0 for isolated systems.

topics.title: Heat Engines, Refrigerators and the Carnot Cycle
topics.description: Cyclic heat engines, thermal efficiency η = W/Q_H = 1 - Q_C/Q_H; Carnot cycle (two isothermal, two adiabatic processes); maximum Carnot efficiency η_Carnot = 1 - T_C/T_H; Coefficient of Performance (COP) of refrigerators.

book_chapters.title: Unit 1: Thermodynamics and Heat Engines

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 2: Electric Fields and Potential covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Coulomb's Law and Electric Field Distribution
topics.description: Quantization and conservation of electric charge; Coulomb's inverse-square law F = k|q1q2|/r^2 in vacuum and dielectric media; Electric field vector E = F/q0; Principle of superposition for discrete and continuous charge distributions.

topics.title: Electric Potential Energy and Electric Potential
topics.description: Electrostatic work and potential energy U = kq1q2/r; Electric potential V = U/q0 = kQ/r; Potential difference ΔV = -∫ E·dl; Equipotential surfaces and relationship E = -dV/dr.

topics.title: Capacitance and Dielectrics
topics.description: Definition of capacitance C = Q/V; Parallel plate capacitor formula C = ε0·A/d; Effect of dielectric constant κ (C = κC0); Series and parallel combinations of capacitors; Energy stored in electrostatic field U = 1/2 CV^2.

topics.title: Motion of Charged Particles in Uniform Electric Fields
topics.description: Trajectory of electron or proton in uniform electric field (parabolic motion analogous to projectile kinematics), acceleration a = qE/m, deflection in cathode ray tube (CRT) and mass spectrometers.

book_chapters.title: Unit 2: Electric Fields and Potential

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Steady Electric Current and Direct Current Circuits
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Steady Electric Current and Direct Current Circuits covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Electric Current, Drift Velocity and Current Density
topics.description: Microscopic conduction model: free electron density n, drift velocity v_d, electric current I = n·q·A·v_d; Current density J = I/A = σE; Electrical conductivity σ and resistivity ρ = 1/σ.

topics.title: Ohm's Law, Resistance and Temperature Dependence
topics.description: Ohmic vs non-ohmic materials; Resistance formula R = ρL/A; Temperature dependence of resistivity ρ(T) = ρ0[1 + α(T - T0)]; Superconductivity phenomenon at critical temperatures.

topics.title: Electromotive Force, Internal Resistance and Terminal Voltage
topics.description: Ideal vs real voltage sources; Electromotive force (EMF) ε, internal resistance r, terminal voltage V = ε - Ir; Maximum power transfer theorem (R_load = r for P_max).

topics.title: Kirchhoff's Laws and Complex Circuit Networks
topics.description: Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL - charge conservation at junctions); Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL - energy conservation in closed loops); Sign conventions for resistors and EMF sources; Solving multi-loop bridge networks.

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Steady Electric Current and Direct Current Circuits

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Magnetism and Electromagnetic Induction covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Magnetic Fields and Magnetic Forces on Charges and Currents
topics.description: Lorentz force on moving charge F = q(v × B) = qvB sin θ; Circular and helical motion of charges in magnetic field (radius r = mv/qB, cyclotron frequency); Magnetic force on current-carrying conductor F = I(L × B) = ILB sin θ.

topics.title: Sources of Magnetic Fields: Biot-Savart and Ampère's Laws
topics.description: Biot-Savart law for magnetic field of current element; Magnetic field around long straight wire B = μ0·I/(2πr); Field at center of circular loop; Field inside an ideal solenoid B = μ0·n·I; Ampère's Circuital Law ∮ B·dl = μ0·I_enc.

topics.title: Faraday's Law and Lenz's Law of Induction
topics.description: Magnetic flux Φ_B = B·A·cos θ; Faraday's induction law ε = -N(dΦ_B/dt); Lenz's law as consequence of conservation of energy (induced current opposes flux change); Motional EMF ε = B·L·v for moving rod.

topics.title: Inductance and Energy in Magnetic Fields
topics.description: Self-inductance L = NΦ/I; Back EMF in inductors ε_L = -L(dI/dt); Mutual inductance M; Magnetic energy stored in inductor U_B = 1/2 L·I^2; Energy density of magnetic field u_B = B^2/(2μ0).

book_chapters.title: Unit 4: Magnetism and Electromagnetic Induction

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 5: Alternating Current Circuits covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Generation of Alternating Current and AC Quantities
topics.description: AC generator principle (rotating coil in uniform B-field); Sinusoidal voltage v(t) = V0 sin(ωt) and current i(t) = I0 sin(ωt - φ); Peak value V0, RMS value V_rms = V0/√2 = 0.707 V0, root-mean-square current I_rms = I0/√2.

topics.title: AC Circuits with Pure R, L, and C Elements
topics.description: Pure resistor (current in phase with voltage); Pure inductor (voltage leads current by 90° or π/2, inductive reactance X_L = ωL = 2πfL); Pure capacitor (current leads voltage by 90°, capacitive reactance X_C = 1/(ωC) = 1/(2πfC)); Phasor diagrams.

topics.title: Series RLC Circuits and Electrical Resonance
topics.description: Impedance Z = √(R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2); Phase angle tan φ = (X_L - X_C)/R; Resonance condition X_L = X_C giving resonant frequency f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)); Quality factor Q and power factor cos φ = R/Z; Average power P_avg = V_rms·I_rms·cos φ.

topics.title: Electrical Transformers and High-Voltage Power Transmission
topics.description: Principle of mutual induction in iron core; Transformer turns ratio V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p = I_p/I_s; Step-up and step-down transformers; Energy losses (Joule heating, eddy currents, hysteresis); Ethiopia's national power grid (GERD to regional sub-stations).

book_chapters.title: Unit 5: Alternating Current Circuits

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 6: Atomic and Nuclear Physics covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Bohr's Model of the Atom and Atomic Spectra
topics.description: Rutherford alpha scattering experiment; Bohr's quantum postulates (quantized angular momentum L = nh/2π); Energy levels of hydrogen E_n = -13.6/n^2 eV; Rydberg formula 1/λ = R_H (1/n1^2 - 1/n2^2); Spectral series: Lyman (UV), Balmer (visible), Paschen (IR).

topics.title: Photoelectric Effect and Wave-Particle Duality
topics.description: Photoelectric threshold frequency f0, work function Φ; Einstein's photon energy equation E = hf = Φ + KE_max = hf0 + e·V_stop; Failure of classical wave theory; de Broglie wavelength λ = h/p = h/(mv); Wave-particle duality of electrons.

topics.title: Nuclear Structure, Mass Defect and Binding Energy
topics.description: Nucleons (protons and neutrons), atomic number Z, mass number A, isotopes; Strong nuclear force; Mass defect Δm = [Z·m_p + (A-Z)m_n] - M_nucleus; Einstein mass-energy equivalence E = Δm·c^2; Binding energy per nucleon curve (maximum at Fe-56).

topics.title: Radioactivity, Nuclear Reactions, Fission and Fusion
topics.description: Natural radioactivity: Alpha decay (He-4 nucleus), Beta-minus (electron + antineutrino), Beta-plus (positron + neutrino), Gamma decay (high-energy photons); Radioactive decay law N(t) = N0 e^(-λt); Half-life T_1/2 = ln 2 / λ = 0.693/λ; Nuclear fission vs thermonuclear fusion.

book_chapters.title: Unit 6: Atomic and Nuclear Physics

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 1: Solutions and Colloidal Dispersions covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Types of Solutions and the Dissolution Process
topics.description: Solute-solvent interactions, enthalpy of solution ΔH_sol = ΔH_solute + ΔH_solvent + ΔH_mix, lattice energy vs hydration energy, factors affecting solubility (nature of solute/solvent, temperature, pressure - Henry's law C = k·P).

topics.title: Concentration Units and Solution Stoichiometry
topics.description: Molarity M (mol/L), Molality m (mol/kg solvent), Mole fraction X_i, Mass percent (% w/w), Parts per million (ppm); Dilution equation M1V1 = M2V2; Acid-base and precipitation stoichiometric calculations.

topics.title: Colligative Properties of Solutions
topics.description: Properties depending strictly on particle number: Vapor pressure lowering (Raoult's law P_A = X_A·P°_A), Boiling point elevation ΔT_b = K_b·m·i, Freezing point depression ΔT_f = K_f·m·i, Osmotic pressure Π = iMRT; van 't Hoff factor i for electrolytes.

topics.title: Colloids and Suspensions
topics.description: Distinguishing true solutions, colloids, and suspensions by particle size; Classification of colloids (sols, gels, aerosols, emulsions, foams); Optical properties (Tyndall effect), kinetic properties (Brownian motion), electrical charge on colloidal particles, coagulation.

book_chapters.title: Unit 1: Solutions and Colloidal Dispersions

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Chemical Equilibrium and Phase Equilibrium
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 2: Chemical Equilibrium and Phase Equilibrium covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: The Concept of Dynamic Chemical Equilibrium
topics.description: Reversible vs irreversible reactions; Characteristics of dynamic equilibrium (rates of forward and reverse reactions are equal, macroscopic concentrations remain constant); Equilibrium law and mass action expression.

topics.title: Equilibrium Constants Kc and Kp
topics.description: Concentration equilibrium constant Kc; Partial pressure constant Kp; Relationship Kp = Kc·(RT)^(Δn); Homogeneous vs heterogeneous equilibria (excluding pure solids and liquids); Reaction quotient Q and predicting direction of shift (Q < K, Q = K, Q > K).

topics.title: Le Chatelier's Principle and Equilibrium Shifts
topics.description: Effect of concentration changes, temperature changes (endothermic vs exothermic reactions - only T changes the value of K), pressure and volume changes for gaseous equilibria; Effect of catalysts (increases rate without shifting position); Industrial optimization of Haber and Contact processes.

topics.title: Phase Equilibrium and Phase Diagrams
topics.description: Liquid-vapor dynamic equilibrium and vapor pressure; Phase diagrams for single-component systems (H2O and CO2); Triple point, critical temperature and critical pressure; Sublimation, melting, and boiling curves.

book_chapters.title: Unit 2: Chemical Equilibrium and Phase Equilibrium

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Acid-Base Equilibria covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Acid-Base Theories and Autoionization of Water
topics.description: Arrhenius, Brønsted-Lowry, and Lewis theories of acids and bases; Conjugate acid-base pairs; Amphiprotic species; Self-ionization of water H2O + H2O ⇌ H3O+ + OH-; Ion-product constant of water Kw = [H3O+][OH-] = 1.0 × 10^(-14) at 25°C.

topics.title: pH, pOH and Strengths of Acids and Bases
topics.description: pH = -log[H3O+], pOH = -log[OH-], pH + pOH = 14; Strong acids and bases (100% dissociation); Weak acids and acid dissociation constant Ka; Weak bases and base dissociation constant Kb; Relationship Ka·Kb = Kw; Percent ionization.

topics.title: Salt Hydrolysis and Acid-Base Character of Salts
topics.description: Hydrolysis reactions of cations and anions in aqueous solution; Salts of strong acid + strong base (neutral pH = 7); Salts of strong acid + weak base (acidic pH < 7); Salts of weak acid + strong base (basic pH > 7); Calculating pH of hydrolyzed salt solutions.

topics.title: Buffer Solutions and Acid-Base Titrations
topics.description: Composition and mechanism of acidic and basic buffer solutions; Henderson-Hasselbalch equation pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA]); Buffer capacity; Strong acid-strong base and weak acid-strong base titration curves; Equivalence point vs end point; Acid-base indicator selection.

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Acid-Base Equilibria

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Electrochemistry covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Oxidation-Reduction Reactions and Electrochemical Cells
topics.description: Oxidation numbers, oxidation as loss of electrons, reduction as gain (OIL RIG); Balancing redox equations using the ion-electron method in acidic and basic media; Galvanic (voltaic) cells vs electrolytic cells; Anode (oxidation) and cathode (reduction); Salt bridge function.

topics.title: Standard Electrode Potentials and Cell EMF
topics.description: Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE, E° = 0.00 V); Standard reduction potentials table; Standard cell EMF E°cell = E°cathode - E°anode; Spontaneity criterion: E°cell > 0 corresponds to ΔG° < 0 (ΔG° = -nFE°cell); Electrochemical series.

topics.title: The Nernst Equation and Commercial Batteries
topics.description: Effect of non-standard concentrations: Nernst equation E = E° - (0.0592/n)·log Q at 298 K; Concentration cells; Primary batteries (dry Leclanché cell, alkaline cell); Secondary batteries (lead-acid accumulator, lithium-ion battery); Fuel cells (H2-O2 fuel cell).

topics.title: Electrolysis and Quantitative Laws of Electrolysis
topics.description: Electrolysis of molten NaCl (Downs cell) and aqueous NaCl (chlor-alkali process); Overpotential; Faraday's First Law (mass deposited proportional to electric charge m ∝ Q); Faraday's Second Law; Faraday's constant F = 96,485 C/mol e-; Industrial electroplating and aluminum refining (Hall-Héroult process).

book_chapters.title: Unit 4: Electrochemistry

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 5: Systematic Organic Chemistry covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Isomerism and Structural Diversity in Organic Compounds
topics.description: Structural isomerism (chain, positional, functional group isomerism); Stereoisomerism: Geometric cis-trans isomerism around C=C double bonds; Optical isomerism, chiral carbon centers, enantiomers, and plane-polarized light rotation.

topics.title: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
topics.description: IUPAC nomenclature; Primary, secondary, tertiary alcohols; Hydrogen bonding and solubility; Reactions: oxidation of 1° alcohols to aldehydes/acids, 2° alcohols to ketones, 3° resist oxidation; Lucas test; Acidity of phenols; Ethers synthesis and inert properties.

topics.title: Aldehydes and Ketones
topics.description: Carbonyl group structure and polarity; IUPAC nomenclature; Nucleophilic addition reactions with HCN, Grignard reagents, and alcohols; Oxidation tests: Tollens' reagent (silver mirror test) and Fehling's solution distinguishing aldehydes from ketones; Addition of 2,4-DNP.

topics.title: Carboxylic Acids, Esters, Fats and Oils
topics.description: Carboxylic acid acidity and resonance stabilization of carboxylate ion; Esterification reaction (carboxylic acid + alcohol in presence of acid catalyst); Hydrolysis of esters; Saponification of fats and oils into soap (sodium carboxylates) and glycerol; Detergent action and cleansing mechanism.

topics.title: Synthetic Polymers and Important Biomolecules
topics.description: Addition polymerization (polyethylene, PVC, polystyrene); Condensation polymerization (nylon-6,6, Dacron polyester); Natural polymers: Carbohydrates (monosaccharides, starch, cellulose), Proteins (amino acids, peptide bonds, denaturation), and Lipids.

book_chapters.title: Unit 5: Systematic Organic Chemistry

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Molecular Genetics and DNA Technology
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 1: Molecular Genetics and DNA Technology covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: DNA Molecular Structure and Semiconservative Replication
topics.description: Watson-Crick double helix model, antiparallel strands (5' to 3' and 3' to 5'), nucleotide units (deoxyribose, phosphate, purine/pyrimidine bases), Chargaff's rules (%A=%T, %G=%C); Semiconservative replication: Helicase, DNA polymerase, RNA primase, Okazaki fragments, and DNA ligase.

topics.title: Transcription and Post-Transcriptional RNA Processing
topics.description: Central dogma of molecular biology; RNA structure vs DNA; Transcription by RNA Polymerase binding promoter region; Template strand reading 3' to 5', mRNA synthesis 5' to 3'; Eukaryotic RNA processing: 5' capping, 3' poly-A tailing, splicing out non-coding introns by spliceosomes.

topics.title: The Genetic Code, Translation and Protein Synthesis
topics.description: Features of the genetic code (triplet, universal, degenerate/redundant, non-overlapping, start codon AUG, stop codons UAA, UAG, UGA); tRNA structure and anticodon loop; Ribosome structure (A, P, E sites); Translation stages: Initiation, Elongation (peptide bond formation), Termination.

topics.title: Recombinant DNA Technology, PCR and Biotechnology Applications
topics.description: Restriction endonucleases ("molecular scissors" cutting palindromic recognition sequences), DNA ligase, plasmid vectors, bacterial transformation; Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR: Denaturation, Annealing, Extension); Gel electrophoresis; Applications in Ethiopian agriculture (tissue culture of teff, coffee) and medicine (recombinant insulin).

book_chapters.title: Unit 1: Molecular Genetics and DNA Technology

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Mendelian Genetics and Inheritance Patterns
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 2: Mendelian Genetics and Inheritance Patterns covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Mendelian Genetics: Monohybrid and Dihybrid Crosses
topics.description: Mendel's experiments on Pisum sativum; Law of Segregation (alleles separate during meiosis, monohybrid 3:1 phenotypic and 1:2:1 genotypic ratios); Law of Independent Assortment (unlinked genes assort independently, dihybrid 9:3:3:1 ratio); Test cross with homozygous recessive.

topics.title: Non-Mendelian Patterns of Inheritance
topics.description: Incomplete dominance (intermediate heterozygote phenotype 1:2:1 ratio, e.g. Snapdragon flowers); Codominance (both alleles expressed simultaneously, e.g. sickle cell trait HbA/HbS, MN blood group); Multiple alleles (ABO blood group system with IA, IB, i); Polygenic quantitative traits (skin color, human height).

topics.title: Sex Determination, Sex-Linkage and Pedigree Analysis
topics.description: Chromosomal sex determination (XX/XY in humans, ZW/ZZ in birds); Sex-linked inheritance of X-linked recessive traits (Hemophilia A, Red-green color blindness); Hemizygous males (XY) expressing recessive alleles; Interpreting human pedigree charts (autosomal dominant/recessive vs X-linked).

topics.title: Mutations and Chromosomal Abnormalities
topics.description: Gene/point mutations (silent, missense, nonsense, frameshift insertions/deletions); Mutagenic agents (UV, ionizing radiation, chemicals); Chromosomal structural alterations (deletion, duplication, inversion, translocation); Numerical aneuploidy due to nondisjunction during meiosis (Down syndrome Trisomy 21, Turner syndrome XO, Klinefelter syndrome XXY).

book_chapters.title: Unit 2: Mendelian Genetics and Inheritance Patterns

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 3: Evolution and Speciation covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Empirical Evidence for Evolutionary Change
topics.description: Paleontological fossil record and transitional fossils (e.g. Archaeopteryx, Lucy/Australopithecus afarensis discovered in the Afar Depression of Ethiopia); Comparative anatomy: Homologous structures (divergent evolution) vs Analogous structures (convergent evolution), vestigial structures; Biochemical and DNA sequence homology.

topics.title: Theories of Evolution: Lamarckism vs. Darwinian Natural Selection
topics.description: Lamarck's theory of inheritance of acquired characteristics and disuse; Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace: Overproduction, struggle for existence, variation within populations, differential survival and reproduction ("survival of the fittest"); Modern evolutionary synthesis combining Mendelian genetics with natural selection.

topics.title: Population Genetics and the Hardy-Weinberg Principle
topics.description: Gene pool, allele frequency (p + q = 1) and genotype frequency (p^2 + 2pq + q^2 = 1); Five conditions for Hardy-Weinberg genetic equilibrium (large population, random mating, no mutation, no gene flow/migration, no natural selection); Evolutionary forces disrupting equilibrium: Genetic drift (bottleneck and founder effects), gene flow, natural selection.

topics.title: Speciation Mechanisms and Ethiopian Endemic Biodiversity
topics.description: Biological species concept; Reproductive isolating mechanisms: Prezygotic (temporal, behavioral, ecological, mechanical, gametic isolation) and Postzygotic (hybrid inviability, hybrid sterility); Allopatric speciation via geographical barriers vs Sympatric speciation (polyploidy); Adaptive radiation of Ethiopian highlands endemic wildlife (Walia Ibex, Ethiopian Wolf, Gelada Baboon).

book_chapters.title: Unit 3: Evolution and Speciation

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Human Physiology and Defence Mechanisms
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Human Physiology and Defence Mechanisms covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Neural Coordination: Action Potentials and Synaptic Transmission
topics.description: Structure of sensory, relay, and motor neurons; Resting membrane potential (-70 mV maintained by Na+/K+ ATPase pump: 3 Na+ out, 2 K+ in); Action potential phases: Depolarization (voltage-gated Na+ channels open, potential reaches +30 mV), Repolarization (K+ channels open), Hyperpolarization, Refractory periods; Saltatory conduction in myelinated axons; Synaptic transmission via neurotransmitter acetylcholine release.

topics.title: Endocrine Coordination and Homeostatic Feedback Loops
topics.description: Ductless endocrine glands and hormone signaling; Hypothalamus-pituitary axis; Blood glucose regulation by pancreatic islets: Beta cells secrete insulin (promotes glycogenesis and glucose uptake), Alpha cells secrete glucagon (stimulates glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis); Thyroid hormones T3/T4 and metabolic rate; Adrenal stress hormones (adrenaline and cortisol); Negative feedback control.

topics.title: The Human Immune System and Defence Mechanisms
topics.description: Innate (non-specific) immunity: Physical/chemical barriers (skin, lysozyme, stomach acid), phagocytes (macrophages, neutrophils), inflammatory response, fever; Adaptive (specific) immunity: Humoral response mediated by B-lymphocytes and antibodies (IgG, IgM, IgA, IgE), Cell-mediated response mediated by cytotoxic T-cells (CD8+) and helper T-cells (CD4+); Active vs passive immunity, vaccination mechanisms.

topics.title: Major Pathogenic Diseases and Public Health in Ethiopia
topics.description: Malaria: Plasmodium falciparum lifecycle between female Anopheles mosquito vector and human host (liver and red blood cell phases), symptoms, Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT); Tuberculosis: Mycobacterium tuberculosis pathogenesis, BCG vaccination, DOTS treatment program; HIV/AIDS: Retrovirus replication cycle, reverse transcriptase, destruction of CD4+ T-helper cells, Antiretroviral therapy (ART); Schistosomiasis lifecycle with freshwater snail intermediate host.

book_chapters.title: Unit 4: Human Physiology and Defence Mechanisms

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: Applied Ecology and Environmental Conservation
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 5: Applied Ecology and Environmental Conservation covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Ecosystem Dynamics, Trophic Levels and Energy Flow
topics.description: Ecosystem components (biotic communities and abiotic factors); Trophic levels: Primary producers (autotrophs), primary consumers (herbivores), secondary/tertiary consumers (carnivores), decomposers; Unidirectional energy flow; Lindeman's 10% ecological efficiency rule (90% lost as metabolic heat and respiration); Ecological pyramids of numbers, biomass, and energy.

topics.title: Biogeochemical Cycles and Nutrient Recycling
topics.description: Carbon cycle: Photosynthesis, cellular respiration, combustion, and greenhouse effect global warming; Nitrogen cycle: Nitrogen fixation by Rhizobium in legume root nodules and free-living Azotobacter, nitrification by Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter, assimilation, ammonification, and denitrification by Pseudomonas; Phosphorus cycle; Eutrophication of water bodies caused by synthetic fertilizer runoff.

topics.title: Environmental Degradation and Climate Resilience in Ethiopia
topics.description: Deforestation causes (firewood, agricultural expansion) and consequences in Ethiopian highlands; Soil erosion mechanisms, terracing, and contour ploughing; Land degradation and desertification; Impact of erratic rainfall and recurring droughts on pastoralist communities; Ethiopia's Green Legacy Initiative and national reforestation campaigns.

topics.title: Biodiversity Conservation and Protected Area Management
topics.description: In-situ conservation: National Parks of Ethiopia (Simien Mountains, Bale Mountains, Awash, Nechisar, Gambella), wildlife sanctuaries (Babille Elephant Sanctuary), biosphere reserves (Kafa coffee forest); Ex-situ conservation: Ethiopian Biodiversity Institute (EBI) genebanks, botanical gardens, and captive breeding programs; Economic and ecological value of preserving endemic genetic resources.

topics.title: Academic Reading: Text Analysis, Tone and Main Ideas
topics.description: Skimming scholarly articles for main idea, scanning for supporting empirical data, evaluating author purpose and objective vs subjective tone, making logical inferences from academic prose, and distinguishing asserted facts from hypotheses.

topics.title: Scholarly Vocabulary: Affixation and Academic Word List
topics.description: Morphological word analysis: Latin and Greek prefixes (anti-, bio-, inter-, poly-, trans-) and suffixes (-tion, -ize, -ous, -able); Contextual collocations in university research papers; Connotative nuances of scholarly synonyms.

topics.title: Advanced Relative Clauses and Sentence Synthesis
topics.description: Defining vs non-defining relative clauses (comma rules, which vs that, who vs whom, whose); Reduced relative clauses (participle clauses using present -ing and past -ed participles); Combining simple sentences into cohesive compound-complex academic sentences.

topics.title: Speaking and Discussion: Academic Seminars and Debates
topics.description: Active listening during scholarly presentations, formulating constructive questions, discourse markers for polite disagreement ("While I acknowledge your point, evidence suggests..."), and summarizing group conclusions.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Advanced Grammatical Structures for Entrance Examinations
book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 2: Advanced Grammatical Structures for Entrance Examinations covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Mastery of Conditional Sentences and Counterfactuals
topics.description: Zero, First, Second, and Third Conditionals review; Mixed conditionals (unreal past action with present consequence: If + past perfect, would + base verb); Formal inversion without 'if' ("Had I known the schedule...", "Were the committee to approve...", "Should you require assistance...").

topics.title: Advanced Passive Voice Constructions
topics.description: Passive with reporting verbs for academic objectivity ("It is widely believed that...", "The findings are said to indicate..."); Passive infinitive and gerund forms; Causative passive structures (have/get something done); Avoiding agent identification when agent is unknown or irrelevant.

topics.title: Reported Speech and Indirect Discourse
topics.description: Tense backshift rules in reported speech (simple present to simple past, present perfect to past perfect); Exceptions when reporting universal scientific truths; Reporting verbs with specific patterns (insist on, apologize for, deny + gerund, advise someone to do); Shifting time and place adverbs.

topics.title: Modals of Deduction, Speculation and Past Regret
topics.description: Present deduction (must be, can't be, might be); Past deduction and speculation (must have been, can't have done, might have seen); Expressing past obligation and regret (should have studied, ought to have submitted); Common multiple-choice distractors in national EUEE entrance exams.

book_chapters.title: Unit 2: Advanced Grammatical Structures for Entrance Examinations

topics.title: Expository Writing: Process Descriptions and Technical Reports
topics.description: Structuring laboratory reports: Introduction, Materials & Methods (passive voice sequential instructions), Results, and Discussion; Sequential connectors (initially, subsequently, simultaneously, following this, ultimately); Precision and concise scientific prose.

topics.title: Cause-and-Effect Discourse Analysis
topics.description: Expressing causal relationships using diverse grammatical structures: Prepositions (due to, owing to, as a consequence of), Conjunctions (since, because, as), Transitional adverbs (consequently, therefore, thus, as a result); Structuring multi-paragraph cause-and-effect analytical essays.

topics.title: Technical Vocabulary and Precise Scientific Phrasing
topics.description: Domain-specific vocabulary in STEM and social sciences; Avoiding vague colloquial language (e.g. replacing "make it bigger" with "amplify/expand", "get rid of" with "eliminate"); Technical collocations and standardized SI measurement phrasing.

topics.title: Interpreting Graphical Data and Technical Visuals
topics.description: Describing trends in charts, graphs, and tables: Upward trends (surge, climb, escalate), downward trends (plummet, decline, dip), fluctuations and plateauing; Quantifying changes using adverbs (substantially, marginally, exponentially).

book_chapters.description: Official Ethiopian Curriculum Unit 4: Persuasive Rhetoric and Public Speaking covering national secondary syllabus competencies and entrance exam prep.

topics.title: Rhetorical Devices and Persuasive Discourse
topics.description: Classical appeals: Ethos (credibility), Pathos (emotional resonance), Logos (logical reasoning and empirical evidence); Rhetorical strategies: Parallelism, rhetorical questions, antithesis, tricolon (rule of three), and identifying common logical fallacies (ad hominem, false dichotomy, slippery slope).

topics.title: Composing Argumentative and Persuasive Essays
topics.description: Developing an arguable, nuanced thesis statement; Structuring introductory hook, body paragraphs with evidence, acknowledging counter-arguments with robust rebuttals, and crafting a resonant concluding call to action.

topics.title: Sentence Inversion for Emphasis and Cleft Sentences
topics.description: Negative adverbial inversion ("Rarely have we witnessed...", "Not only did they succeed, but they also...", "Under no circumstances should you..."); It-clefts ("It was the lack of infrastructure that caused the delay") and Wh-clefts ("What the research demonstrates is...").

topics.title: Public Speaking, Oratory and Pronunciation Intonation
topics.description: Vocal projection, pacing, pauses for emphasis; Intonation patterns in statements vs questions; Sentence stress highlighting contrasting key words; Overcoming public speaking anxiety and engaging an audience.

topics.description: Listening for lecture signposting language (introducing topics, digressing, emphasizing key takeaways, signaling exam focus); Implementing the Cornell note-taking system: Cue column, main notes section, and summary block; Using standard academic abbreviations.

topics.title: Academic Integrity: Paraphrasing, Summarizing and Citation
topics.description: Understanding plagiarism and intellectual honesty; Techniques for effective paraphrasing: changing word forms, using synonyms, altering sentence structures while preserving original meaning; Summarizing multi-page articles into concise abstracts; Basic citation formatting.

topics.description: Writing formal university and scholarship application letters; Statement of Purpose (SOP) structure; Register differences between formal letters (Dear Professor..., Sincerely) and informal emails; Formatting a modern student Curriculum Vitae (CV).

topics.title: Entrance Examination Test-Taking Strategies
topics.description: Strategic time management on the 100-question English EUEE paper; Process of elimination for tricky grammar distractors; Contextual inference shortcuts for reading comprehension; Avoiding panic traps in vocabulary questions.
